dataset.name: DROID subset distributed with the Ctrl-World checkout

selection_policy: Frozen before any ablation-checkpoint held-out evaluation. Episode 1799 is absent from the training sample manifest, has 41 decoded frames, and supports the same replay start with three paired inference seeds.
claim_boundary: One independently held-out episode with three paired inference seeds supports mechanism screening only. It cannot establish broad task or dataset-level improvement.
